relations.description: The procedure uses 5GMM messages as transport mechanism.
5GMM message can contain 5GSM messages as payload.
5GMM message can contain LPP messages as payload.
5GMM message can contain SOR transparent containers as payload.
5GMM message can contain UE policy containers as payload.
5GMM message can contain UE parameters update transparent containers as payload.
5GMM message can contain location services messages as payload.
5GMM message can contain CIoT user data containers as payload.
5GMM message can contain service-level-AA containers as payload.
5GMM message can contain event notifications for upper layers as payload.
